property_summary: For any input uint256 v, calling SetMinSum(v) on the reference C always results in MinSum == v (the contract accepts zero), whereas the mutant rejects v==0 causing MinSum to remain unchanged or the call to revert; the test fuzzes v and asserts that after SetMinSum(v) returns successfully, c.MinSum() equals v.
change_summary: Set MinSum only when provided value is nonzero by adding a require, so zero inputs will not change MinSum.
